crossRefs.note: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

people.name: Sceva
people.line: Jewish chief priest whose seven sons attempted to exorcise demons

translations.web: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
translations.bsb: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
translations.kjv: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
translations.asv: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, a chief priest, who did this.
